items.name: Cloak of the War-Camp
items.lore: Ceannai blue, with a Hibernian knot in grey thread. Given to those who took Kedger's war-camp.

items.name: Salmon-Totem Torc
items.lore: Cut from the salmon totem the Sentinels pulled down. The eriu say it still swims upstream in your sleep.

items.name: Sentinel's Watch-Ring
items.lore: A Sentinel's ring, with the south road engraved round it.

items.name: Palisade-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Iron-banded, for men who go through palisades rather than over them.

items.name: Eriu Trophy Belt
items.lore: Fish-scale and bronze, taken from the war-camp. The eriu want it back.

items.name: Kaen Kedger's War-Horn
items.lore: The horn that called the eriu clans to war. It doesn't sound now. Mostly.

draughts: The Sentinels carry it on the south road. It tastes of nettles and does the job.
Milk of crushed hazelnuts from the well. The filid swear by it.
Salt from the river that shouldn't be salt. It keeps you on your feet.
For the moment the eriu come out of the trees all at once.
The port's own. Everything comes back a little faster after a pint.
